title: Design: a part sale's field label still reads "Sales representative"
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Create an open, uninvoiced part sale for this test for that customer.
  • Set the browser window to 1440 pixels wide with the zoom at 100%.
  • Open the design pictures "partsale-01-n3-rest.png" (board 3.1), "partsale-02-n3-hover.png" (board 3.2) and "partsale-04-n3-picked-hover.png" (board 3.4) attached to this case beside the browser window at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Open the part sale in that browser window.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Without hovering, read the label of the part sale's representative field.
  2. Hover over the field and compare it with the picture of board 3.2.
  3. Pick sales rep A from the field's list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The label reads "Sales representative", with a small "r" (not "Sales Representative").
  • There is one field.
  • There is no + or remove x beside it.

Step 2:

  • The hover look is the part sale field's own (box and arrow across the full width of the card, as in the picture).
  • No + or remove x appears.

Step 3:

  • The field reads sales rep A.
  • Its label still reads "Sales representative".
  • There is still no + and no remove x.

The part sale's Sales Representative field comes from Part Sales Update v1 (SV-10266). If that is not on the build being tested, mark this case Blocked and say so.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative)

  • S2-N2: “A part sale's card has no + button. A part sale keeps one Sales Representative field, exactly as Part Sales Update v1 builds it: its label stays "Sales representative" and its look and behavior do not change.”

From: Chris Ward's answers, question sheet of 19 Oct 2026, Google Sheet 17Ry1BtRTPEkecBP5TlgAE0T93Ai1TQewdJ7B7WpWDBQ, tab "Questions for Chris", rows 6-43 (answered 19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 7: “7. (b) Nothing changes: keep the label and the look exactly as Part Sales Update v1 built them.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 3.1 The Sales Representative field; 3.2 Hover; 3.4 A rep picked, hovered (the attached pictures are these boards).

Where the design and the PRD differ: Boards 3.1 to 3.4 read "Sales Representative" with a capital R (checked on a 4x crop of board 3.1). PRD v10 and Chris Ward's answer 7 keep the label "Sales representative"; this case follows them, and the design's capital R is not what to expect.
